llm_judge_reasons: Critical runtime issue: Command uses pipe operator '|' in array format without shell=true, which will fail at runtime
The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'undefined_publisher.test'] will treat '|' as a literal argument when shell=false (default in get_vm_command_line)
The pipe operator requires shell=true to be interpreted correctly by the shell
The semantic logic is otherwise correct: listing installed extensions and checking for the specific extension ID is the right approach to verify installation
The extension ID 'undefined_publisher.test' appears plausible for the test.vsix file but cannot be independently verified from the evaluator alone
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'shell': true to the result config to enable shell pipe execution: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": [...], "shell": true}
Alternative: Use a single string command with shell=true: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": "code --list-extensions | grep undefined_publisher.test", "shell": true}
